deekshabhoomi.name: Deekshabhoomi (Sacred Buddhist Stupa)
deekshabhoomi.description: Asia's largest hollow Buddhist stupa, marking the sacred ground where Dr. B.R. Ambedkar embraced Buddhism with lakhs of followers on Ashoka Vijaya Dashami in 1956.
deekshabhoomi.best_time_to_visit: October to March (Special gathering on Dhammachakra Pravartan Din)

sitabuldi_fort.name: Sitabuldi Fort
sitabuldi_fort.description: Strategic twin-hill fortress constructed by Mudhoji II Bhonsle, site of the historic 1817 Battle of Sitabuldi, offering panoramic vistas of central Nagpur.
sitabuldi_fort.best_time_to_visit: Open to public on national holidays (Republic Day, Independence Day, Maharashtra Day)

zero_mile_stone.name: Zero Mile Stone & Freedom Park
zero_mile_stone.description: Monumental sandstone pillar and four plaster horses erected in 1907 by the British as the exact geographic midpoint of undivided India for all distance measurements.
zero_mile_stone.best_time_to_visit: Evenings (Right at Zero Mile Freedom Park Metro)

futala_lake.name: Futala Lake & Waterfront Promenade
futala_lake.description: Historic 200-year-old reservoir built by the Bhonsle kings, renowned for its lively illuminated waterfront promenade, street snacks, and world-class multimedia musical fountain.

ambazari_lake_garden.name: Ambazari Lake & Botanical Garden
ambazari_lake_garden.description: Nagpur's largest natural lake and origin point of the Nag River, fringed by mango orchards (Amba), 25 acres of manicured botanical lawns, and pedal boating.
ambazari_lake_garden.best_time_to_visit: Mornings or sunset (Close to Ambazari Lake Metro)

dragon_palace_temple.name: Dragon Palace Temple (Lotus Temple of Nagpur)
dragon_palace_temple.description: Striking Japanese Buddhist peace temple in Kamptee inaugurated in 1999, housing an internationally acclaimed single-block sandalwood Buddha statue.

raman_science_centre.name: Raman Science Centre & Planetarium
raman_science_centre.description: Interactive science wonderland named after Nobel Laureate Sir C.V. Raman, featuring a digital planetarium, 3D science theater, and open prehistoric animal park.

seminary_hills.name: Seminary Hills
seminary_hills.description: Wooded hillock named after St. Charles Seminary, offering elevated walking trails, lush Japanese gardens, and a spectacular bird's-eye panorama of Nagpur.

maharajbagh_zoo.name: Maharajbagh Zoo & Botanical Garden
maharajbagh_zoo.description: Historic garden established in 1894 by the Bhonsle kings, housing leopards, royal deer, birds, and an expansive agricultural botanical conservatory.

shri_ganesh_mandir_tekdi.name: Shri Ganesh Mandir Tekdi
shri_ganesh_mandir_tekdi.description: Over 250-year-old self-manifested (Swayambhu) Ganesha shrine perched on a small knoll adjacent to Nagpur Railway Station, deeply revered across Vidarbha.

koradi_temple.name: Shri Mahalaxmi Jagdamba Mata Temple (Koradi)
koradi_temple.description: Venerated pilgrimage temple on the banks of Koradi Lake dedicated to Goddess Mahalaxmi Jagdamba, attracting over a million devotees during Chaitra and Sharad Navratri.

gorewada_bio_park.name: Balasaheb Thackeray Gorewada International Zoo & Safari
gorewada_bio_park.description: India's largest wildlife safari park spanning 1,914 hectares beside Gorewada Lake, offering open safari buses into Indian leopard, sloth bear, and Royal Bengal tiger reserves.
gorewada_bio_park.best_time_to_visit: October to March (Advance online safari booking recommended)

narrow_gauge_rail_museum.name: Narrow Gauge Rail Museum (Kadbi Chowk)
narrow_gauge_rail_museum.description: Unique railway heritage museum showcasing the bygone era of Central Railway's narrow gauge lines with vintage steam engines, royal inspection saloons, and mini toy train rides.

swaminarayan_temple_nagpur.name: BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir (Wathoda)
swaminarayan_temple_nagpur.description: Magnificent pink Rajasthani sandstone temple complex in Wathoda, adorned with hundreds of intricately hand-sculpted pillars, domes, gardens, and spiritual exhibits.

ramtek_fort_temple.name: Ramtek Fort Temple (Gad Mandir)
ramtek_fort_temple.description: Ancient 600-year-old hilltop fort temple dedicated to Lord Rama where he rested during exile; celebrated by Sanskrit poet Kalidasa as the setting for 'Meghaduta'.
ramtek_fort_temple.best_time_to_visit: November to February (Ram Navami or Kalidas Festival)

khindsi_lake.name: Khindsi Lake & Water Sports Resort
khindsi_lake.description: Sprawling lake cradled within green Satpura hills near Ramtek, acclaimed as Central India's premier inland water sports center for speedboating and pedal cruising.

telankhedi_hanuman_temple.name: Telankhedi Hanuman & Kalyaneshwar Temple
telankhedi_hanuman_temple.description: Hilltop temple complex overlooking Futala Lake, home to a revered ancient Hanuman idol and historic Kalyaneshwar Shiva shrine built by Queen Bakabai.

kasturchand_park.name: Kasturchand Park & Royal Pavilion
kasturchand_park.description: Nagpur's premier central historic maidan gifted in 1920 by industrialist Sir Kasturchand Daga, featuring an ornate Rajasthani stone bandstand pavilion.

central_museum_nagpur.name: Central Museum Nagpur (Ajab Bangla)
central_museum_nagpur.description: Established in 1863, one of India's oldest museums locally known as 'Ajab Bangla', showcasing dinosaur fossils, Megalithic artifacts, and royal Bhonsle armory.

poddareshwar_ram_mandir.name: Poddareshwar Ram Mandir
poddareshwar_ram_mandir.description: Opulent marble and sandstone temple built in 1923 by Jamnadhar Poddar, world-renowned for originating Nagpur's grand Ram Navami Shobhayatra procession.

gandhisagar_lake.name: Gandhisagar Lake (Shukrawari Talao)
gandhisagar_lake.description: Historic water reservoir created in the 18th century by Chand Sultan, featuring a central island temple, pedestrian jogging tracks, and evening illuminations.

itwari_market.name: Itwari Heritage Wholesale Market
itwari_market.description: Nagpur's centuries-old commercial backbone operating since Sunday market days in Gond times, packed with traditional Sarafa gold souks, textiles, and spices.

sitabuldi_main_road.name: Sitabuldi Main Road Shopping District
sitabuldi_main_road.description: The bustling retail heartbeat of Nagpur, packed with garment boutiques, footwear bazaars, street cuisine, directly connected to Sitabuldi Metro Interchange.

dharampeth_shopping.name: Dharampeth Cultural & Jewellery High Street
dharampeth_shopping.description: Upscale cultural quarter famed for prestigious jewellery houses, boutique cafes, the Children's Traffic Park, and authentic morning Tarri Poha joints.
dharampeth_shopping.best_time_to_visit: Morning for Tarri Poha or evening for shopping

adasa_ganesh_temple.name: Adasa Ganpati Temple (Vidarbha Ashtavinayak)
adasa_ganesh_temple.description: Ancient monolithic 12-foot stone Ganesha sanctum dating back 4,000 years according to local lore, primary shrine among Vidarbha's eight Ashtavinayak temples.

sakkardara_lake.name: Sakkardara Lake & Garden
sakkardara_lake.description: Historic lake garden established by the Bhonsle dynasty as an eastern pleasure retreat, accompanied by the scenic Kashibai temple sanctum.

dargah_baba_tajuddin.name: Dargah Hazrat Baba Tajuddin (Tajabad Sharif)
dargah_baba_tajuddin.description: Venerated Sufi shrine honoring the great 19th-century saint Baba Tajuddin, visited by people of all faiths seeking solace, free langar, and spiritual healing.

vca_jamtha_stadium.name: Vidarbha Cricket Association Stadium (VCA Jamtha)
vca_jamtha_stadium.description: State-of-the-art 45,000-seater international cricket stadium praised by global cricketers for world-class dressing rooms, lush outfield, and sporting test pitches.

japanese_rose_garden.name: Japanese Rose Garden (Seminary Hills)
japanese_rose_garden.description: Serene botanical park modeled on minimalist Japanese landscaping, blooming with exotic multi-colored rose varieties, iron gazebos, and pine avenues.
japanese_rose_garden.best_time_to_visit: Winter months (December to February) when roses bloom fully

krazy_castle_aqua_park.name: Krazy Castle Aqua Park
krazy_castle_aqua_park.description: Nagpur's popular family amusement and aquatic park near Ambazari Lake, featuring twisting waterslides, splash zones, and thrilling roller coasters.

dhapewada_vithoba_temple.name: Dhapewada Vithoba Temple (Pandharpur of Vidarbha)
dhapewada_vithoba_temple.description: Venerated Vithoba temple on the banks of Chandrabhaga River, hailed as the 'Pandharpur of Vidarbha' drawing vast gatherings during Ashadhi Ekadashi.

nagardhan_fort.name: Nagardhan Fort & Subterranean Baoli
nagardhan_fort.description: Historic fortress built by Raghuji Bhonsle I atop ancient Vakataka dynasty capital ruins, featuring dramatic brick ramparts and a deep underground stepwell.

mansar_excavations.name: Mansar Vakataka Archaeological Excavations
mansar_excavations.description: Major 5th-century archaeological complex revealing the grand palace and Pravareshvara temple of King Pravarasena II of the Vakataka dynasty.

sczcc_cultural_centre.name: South Central Zone Cultural Centre (SCZCC)
sczcc_cultural_centre.description: Government cultural hub organizing the famous annual Orange City Craft Mela, featuring open-air tribal art installations, sculpture gardens, and folk recitals.

haldirams_planet_food.name: Haldiram's Food Planet (Shankar Nagar)
haldirams_planet_food.description: Flagship culinary emporium in the hometown of Haldiram's, famous worldwide for authentic Nagpur Orange Burfi, Soan Papdi, and regional thalis.

all_saints_cathedral_nagpur.name: All Saints' Cathedral (Civil Lines)
all_saints_cathedral_nagpur.description: Imposing 1857 Anglican Gothic cathedral in Civil Lines designed by Sir William Emerson, boasting soaring arches, pipe organ, and brilliant stained-glass windows.

nagpur_high_court.name: Bombay High Court Nagpur Bench (Poem in Stone)
nagpur_high_court.description: Stately Anglo-Gothic sandstone judicial palace opened in 1940, acclaimed by architecture critics as a 'Poem in Stone' with its monumental central dome.
nagpur_high_court.best_time_to_visit: Daytime architectural viewing from Civil Lines

civil_lines_nagpur.name: Civil Lines Tree-Canopied Boulevards
civil_lines_nagpur.description: Nagpur's greenest residential and administrative enclave lined with century-old tamarind, banyan, and flowering Gulmohar canopies, perfect for quiet evening drives.

sai_mandir_wardha_road.name: Shri Sai Baba Mandir (Wardha Road)
sai_mandir_wardha_road.description: One of Nagpur's most frequented spiritual sanctuaries on Wardha Road near Chhatrapati Square, consecrated with an authentic marble idol of Shirdi Sai Baba.

surabardi_dam.name: Surabardi Dam & Lake Reservoir
surabardi_dam.description: Scenic earthen dam off Amravati Road nestled among low hillocks, popular among Nagpurians for weekend barbecues, rural cycling, and golden sunset reflections.

children_traffic_park.name: Children's Traffic Park (Dharampeth)
children_traffic_park.description: Lively recreational park in Dharampeth designed with scaled-down traffic signals, road crossings, pedal-kart circuits, and food stalls.

vr_nagpur_mall.name: VR Nagpur Mall (Medical Square)
vr_nagpur_mall.description: Central Nagpur's premier lifestyle shopping and entertainment destination, featuring top fashion brands, food court, gaming zone, and INOX multiplex.

zilpi_lake.name: Zilpi Lake (Hingna)
zilpi_lake.description: Picturesque secluded lake nestled amidst Hingna's undulating terrain, renowned for tranquility, lakeside camping, and weekend nature escapes.

waki_woods.name: Waki Woods Eco-Nature Retreat
waki_woods.description: Expansive forested riverbank retreat on the Kanhan River, popular for tent camping, archery, riverside nature walks, and authentic rural Saoji lunches.

pench_tiger_reserve_gate.name: Pench Tiger Reserve (Mowgli's Jungle Book Land)
pench_tiger_reserve_gate.description: Legendary tiger sanctuary that inspired Rudyard Kipling's 'The Jungle Book', located on the Nagpur-Jabalpur corridor, offering exhilarating open-top jeep safaris.

umred_karhandla_sanctuary.name: Umred Karhandla Wildlife Sanctuary
umred_karhandla_sanctuary.description: Thriving tiger reserve near Nagpur made world-famous by the legendary tiger 'Jai', boasting high tiger densities and scenic forest jeep safaris.

tadoba_tiger_reserve_gateway.name: Tadoba-Andhari Tiger Reserve Gateway
tadoba_tiger_reserve_gateway.description: Known as 'The Jewel of Vidarbha', Maharashtra's oldest and largest national park, accessible from Nagpur, renowned worldwide for highest tiger sighting probabilities.

air_force_maintenance_museum.name: IAF Maintenance Command Heritage Centre (Vayusena Nagar)
air_force_maintenance_museum.description: Prestige military aviation display at Vayusena Nagar exhibiting decommissioned fighter aircraft, radar systems, aero-engines, and Indian Air Force history.

telankhedi_bir_lake.name: Telankhedi Garden & Nursery
telankhedi_bir_lake.description: Charming government botanical nursery and heritage garden opposite Telankhedi Lake, offering ornamental plants, rose nurseries, and tranquil greenery.

chitnavis_centre.name: Chitnavis Centre (Civil Lines)
chitnavis_centre.description: Nagpur's premier non-profit arts and cultural complex in Civil Lines, hosting art galleries, open-air amphitheatre performances, and literary dialogues.
